title: Home screen
description: A greeting header, the hero panel the app is about (a card, a balance, today's plan), stat tiles, a list of next actions, a sheet and a loading skeleton

quality.hero: One hero panel near the top, background="surface" border radius="l" padding="20", holding the screen's main number or card and its one primary Button
quality.tiles: Stat tiles in a Row gap="12", each a panel with flex={1}: a label-default-s label over a display-strong-xs value
quality.actions: Next actions as Cards with direction="row": an icon box, a title and a subline in a Column flex={1}, and a chevronRight
quality.loading: Skeletons in the shape of the screen while it loads, never a lone Spinner
quality.rhythm: paddingX="20", gap="24" between sections, "12" inside them
